high.title: Global Oil Prices Exceed $115/Barrel as Houthi Forces Enter Conflict, US Deploys Additional Troops to Middle East
high.summary: Oil prices surged at the opening of Sunday trading as Middle East officials gathered in Islamabad to discuss de-escalation efforts. Brent crude reached $115.73/barrel, up $3 from Friday's high of $112.57, while WTI hit $103.13/barrel. Both Brent and WTI gained approximately 3% at the session open. Oil prices have risen sharply since the US and Israel began bombing Iran in late February, with Iran retaliating by closing the Strait of Hormuz. About 20% of the world's oil and LNG supply passes through this waterway off Iran's coast. Major oil centers across the Middle East have also suffered damage in the conflict, further straining global supply chains. This oil price surge will directly impact Vietnam's inflation, fuel import costs, and potentially put pressure on the VND through higher current account deficits and increased energy subsidies.

high.title: Four Major State Banks Sharply Increase Savings Interest Rates: Which Term Offers the Highest Rate?
high.summary: After maintaining low rates for an extended period, the four major state banks (Agribank, Vietcombank, BIDV, and VietinBank) have simultaneously raised deposit rates sharply in March 2026. The highest rate among these banks has reached 6.5% per annum, up significantly from the 5.2-5.3% range maintained throughout 2025. Agribank offers 6.5%/year for 24-month terms, while 12-18 month terms reach 5.9%. Vietcombank raised 12-month rates to 5.9%. This coordinated rate hike by state banks signals potential monetary tightening ahead of SBV policy moves. Higher deposit rates could attract VND deposits, support the currency, and indicate banks' need for funding amid credit growth. Foreign investors should watch for SBV's response and potential policy rate adjustments.

high.title: Selling Gold to Make Bank Deposits Due to Sharp Interest Rate Increases
high.summary: A Hanoi businesswoman recently sold 2 SJC gold bars to switch to bank deposits due to rising interest rates. Despite selling at VND 170 million/tael (below her VND 172 million purchase price), she calculated that depositing VND 340 million at 8.5% annual rate would yield VND 14.45 million after 6 months - providing stable, safe returns without worry. Many investors are reconsidering their asset allocation as deposit rates rise sharply. This trend reflects changing investor preferences as Vietnamese banks compete for deposits with higher rates, potentially reducing gold demand and supporting VND liquidity. The shift from gold to VND deposits could strengthen domestic currency demand and provide banks with more funding for lending operations.

medium.title: Expert View: Period of Strong Volatility May Not Be Over, VN-Index Scenario of Retreating to 1,570 Points Should Be Considered
medium.summary: Experts warn that despite VN-Index recovering to 1,670 points after losing the 1,600 mark, the volatility period may not be over. Low trading volumes during the recovery reflect continued caution and limited money flow return. Market analysts suggest investors remain cautious and consider a downside scenario to 1,570 points.

medium.title: VN-Index Gains Over 80 Points This Week, Has the Stock Market Bottomed?
medium.summary: After three weeks of sharp decline, VN-Index recovered over 81 points from short-term lows, closing the week at 1,672.80 points (+1.52%). The recovery occurred after Middle East conflict de-escalation news and fuel price management measures. However, experts caution that risks remain due to low liquidity during the bounce.

medium.title: Government Adds VND 8,000 Billion to Fuel Price Stabilization Fund
medium.summary: Prime Minister approved Decision 483 adding VND 8,000 billion from 2025 central budget surplus to the Fuel Price Stabilization Fund. This provides additional fiscal buffer to manage domestic fuel price volatility amid Middle East conflict impacts on global oil prices.

medium.title: Proposal to Continue Tax Exemption for Gasoline and Oil Until End of June 2026
medium.summary: Ministry of Finance proposes extending 0% tax rates on gasoline, diesel, and aviation fuel until end-June 2026, following current measures that expire April 15. This includes environmental protection tax, VAT, and special consumption tax exemptions to cushion fuel price impacts on the economy.

medium.title: VPBank Plans to Become First Vietnamese Bank with Charter Capital Over VND 100,000 Billion
medium.summary: VPBank plans to issue shares from retained earnings at 26.04% ratio to increase charter capital to VND 100,000 billion, potentially becoming Vietnam's first bank to reach this milestone. The bank also plans 5% cash dividend payment worth VND 3,966 billion in Q2-3/2026.

medium.title: SJC Gold and Plain Gold Ring Prices Morning March 30
medium.summary: Gold prices remain stable at VND 169.8-172.8 million/tael for both SJC gold and plain gold rings. International gold prices fluctuated sharply last week, dropping to near $4,130/ounce before recovering to around $4,500/ounce by week-end, currently at $4,493/ounce.
